slides.title: Clinical Trial Intake & Consent
slides.subtitle: IRB Protocol Gate, Eligibility Screening & Immutable Audit Ledger

body.text: Multi-site oncology trials lose enrollment velocity and risk audit findings when screening checklists and IRB consent versions are tracked in spreadsheets.

items: Zero enrollments permitted when any exclusion criterion is triggered.
Every e-consent must match the currently active IRB protocol version.
Every candidate state transition writes an append-only audit entry.
Free-text notes allow accidental protocol deviations.
No automatic check against active IRB version.
Manual status overrides bypass PI sign-off.
Semantic status badges for eligibility and consent.
SQLite schema for candidates, criteria, consents, and audit events.
Server-side eligibility and IRB version enforcement.
End-to-end Playwright verification of gate refusals.

slides.title: Decision: Approve Build Plan & Gates
slides.subtitle: Sign off on IRB consent version enforcement and PI review queue before implementation.
